ideas.title: Following the Money: Investigating Fraud in Government Programs
ideas.description: This story would investigate the scope and impact of fraud in government programs, including housing and federal benefits.
questions: What is the total amount of fraud in government programs?
How effective are current measures to prevent and detect fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant waste and abuse in government spending. By analyzing data and public records, we can identify patterns and connections that may lead to further investigation and accountability.
